name: Hadaka Apron Gakuen
source:
Main character does not have a girlfriend yet, but he has a distinctive ideal that he seeks in women. And that is "Naked apron looks good"! One day he goes to bed early and wakes up in a town where everyone wears naked aprons. This must be heavenly reward for his dedication!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-july-2004-dear-my-friend.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公还没有女朋友，却对女性怀有一个独特理想：必须适合“裸体围裙”！一天，他早早入睡，醒来后发现自己身处一座所有人都穿着裸体围裙的城镇。这一定是他坚持信念所得的天国奖赏！

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-july-2004-dear-my-friend.html]vndbreview[/url]]
